title: This Bird Hides 33,000 Seeds and Finds Them Months Later

scenes.text: One bird hides thirty-three thousand seeds, then finds them later.
It's Clark's nutcracker, and it lives in the mountains of the American West.
It buries them in more than twenty-five hundred different spots.
No map. No notes. Just memory.
It remembers most of those spots for seven to nine months.
Thirty-three thousand seeds, all in its head.

description:
One bird hides thirty-three thousand seeds, then finds them later.
Clark's nutcracker buries seeds in more than 2,500 spots and remembers most of the locations for seven to nine months.
How many of your passwords can you remember?
first_comment: Be honest: could you remember where you parked 2,500 times?
